newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Gatic confirms failure to pay bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Gatic confirms failure to pay bond.

text.p: Argentina's Gatic, manufacturer of Adidas, New Balance and other sportswear, confirmed Tuesday it had failed to pay off a $40 million Eurobond that matured on Monday.
Salvador Ritaca, a senior aide to the company's president, told Reuters Gatic had failed to make the payment. First news of the failure were reported by traders Monday.
Ritaca said the company is currently in talks with Standard Chartered and local Banco Comafi, the original underwriters of the issue, to find a way of restructuring the bond.
Ritaca said, "at this moment we are in talks with Comafi and Standard Chartered trying to find a solution to the payment of interest."
He added that "it will be impossible" to attend to the payment of the whole bond, but "we are in a position to restructure the bond."

Gatic suffered heavily from the decline in the economy in 1995. Sales at the end of the fiscal year ending in February will be $300 million, while financial and bank liabilities will total $130 million, said Ritaca. The company has 6,000 employees.
